why: Pins the WIRING and the polarity of 'no opinion' in one mutation, the way the aim-hold entry pins its own. Inverted, teal's plan is never persisted (the countdown never advances, so the span never elapses) while brown's and grey's decisions -- which never evaluate a plan -- would clear a plan the tank still holds. teal.test.ts probes tealDecision directly and stays entirely green either way, so only a dispatcher-level test can catch this.
killedBy: shot-plan write-back (issue #332) a decision with NO shot plan leaves an existing one untouched
